checks.evidence: Retrieval‑Augmented Generation, called RAG, is a way to get better answers from an AI. First we have a question. Then we look in our own notes for a short piece of text that may help. We give that text and the question to a language model – a computer program that can write sentences after learning from many examples. The model uses the text to write an answer. This whole process is called RAG because we **retrieve** (find) useful text and then **generate** (write) an answer [S1].
